summary.en: Carries the load around a fixed pivot.

detail.en: A massless beam in an ideal planar balance. Its displayed length is 0.30 m. The load can be placed at 0.15 or 0.30 m from the pivot. The equivalent perpendicular pull acts 0.04 m from that pivot; it is not a diagram of the actual biceps line of pull [S34].

summary.en: Applies a vertical downward force.

detail.en: An abstract point load. The force value is chosen in newtons, not inferred from this block’s size or material. Zero removes the external load force, not all real forces in a human arm [S34].
detail.zh: 抽象点负载。力值用牛顿选择，不由方块的大小或材料推算。零表示无外加负载力，并不表示真实手臂上所有力都消失 [S34]。
